title: Support api.met.no in Plasma's Weather widget
line: The Weather widget can now show forecasts from MET Norway (api.met.no), which also finds small towns and villages.
explanation: The Weather widget only has BBC, DWD, Environment Canada, NOAA and Open-Meteo providers, so api.met.no (the source KWeather uses) can't be picked. Open MR 1040 by Viorel-Cătălin Răpițeanu adds a metno ion (photon by komoot for place search, api.met.no locationforecast for the forecast) and rounds precipitation chances to whole numbers. The MR was written before the June port of ions to QDateTime, so it no longer built: this branch applies it on current master, gives each day a QDateTime timestamp instead of the removed setWeekDay() label (the widget now derives Today/weekday names itself), and adds the ion next to open-meteo in CMake.

commits.message:
applets/weather: Add metno to weather providers

The weather widget could not use MET Norway's api.met.no, which finds
small towns and villages and has accurate forecasts. This adds a metno
ion using it, with places searched through photon by komoot.

BUG: 496066

media.caption: Master: searching "Reine" only offers BBC, NOAA and Open-Meteo places, no MET Norway
With the change: MET Norway results for Reine and other small places appear in the list
Reine (Moskenes) via MET Norway: current conditions and 7-day day/night forecast, credited to the Norwegian Meteorological Institute
